title: Baobab Event Registry
description: Platform index of canonical event types (ADR-SHARED-018 SS3.3). It indexes the AsyncAPI definitions; it does not replace them. The payload schema of each type is the one its AsyncAPI message declares.

asyncapi.description: The AsyncAPI document that defines the message and its payload.

producer.description: The one engine authorised to produce this type. Required unless the lifecycle is PROPOSED.

lifecycle.description: PROPOSED: the contract is defined but no producer authority is assigned yet. ACTIVE: a registered producer may emit it.

supersedes.description: Legacy types this canonical type replaces (ADR-SHARED-018 SS9). The only place a legacy com.nabhold.* type may appear in contracts/.

naming_exception.description: Why an already-published type keeps a name that breaks the SS3.4 hygiene rules (for example an engine token). Never granted to a new type.
